relationships.subject: ephrin-B2
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings support the conclusion that ephrin-B2 acts directly on sensory neurons through the EphB2 receptor to cause mechanical sensitization, hyperalgesic priming and enhanced responses to PGE2

relationships.subject: ephrin-B2
relationships.evidence_quote: Both male and female mice developed dose-dependent mechanical hypersensitivity in response to ephrin-B2, and both sexes showed hyperalgesic priming when challenged with PGE

relationships.subject: ephrin-B2
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed that ephrin-B2-Fc treatment induced a significant increase in eIF4E phosphorylation that was completely blocked by eFT508

relationships.subject: MNK1
relationships.evidence_quote: Acute nociceptive behaviors and hyperalgesic priming were blocked in mice lacking MNK1 (Mknk1 knockout mice) and by eFT508, a specific MNK inhibitor.

relationships.subject: eFT508
relationships.evidence_quote: Acute mechanical hypersensitivity and hyperalgesic priming were blocked with eFT508 (10 mg/kg) pre-treatment

key_findings: Ephrin-B2 induces mechanical hypersensitivity and hyperalgesic priming in male and female mice via sensory-neuron EphB2 and MNK1.
In human DRG neurons ephrin-B2 raises eIF4E phosphorylation and PGE2 responses, both blocked by eFT508.
